shortDescription: CyberArk Safe Management using Privilege Cloud Shared Services REST APIs.

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: A string containing the base URL of the server hosting CyberArk's Privileged Cloud ISP SDK.

options.name: auto_purge_enabled
options.description: Whether or not to automatically purge files after the end of the Object History Retention Period defined in the Safe properties.

options.name: cyberark_session
options.description: Dictionary set by a CyberArk authentication containing the different values to perform actions on a logged-on CyberArk session. Please see M(cyberark.isp.cyberark_authentication) module for an example of cyberark_session.

options.name: location
options.description: The location of the Safe in the Vault.

options.name: logging_file
options.description: Setting the log file name and location for troubleshooting logs.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output to the C(logging_file) value.

options.name: managing_cpm
options.description: The name of the CPM user who will manage the new Safe.

options.name: number_of_days_retention
options.description: The number of days that password versions are saved in the Safe.

options.name: number_of_versions_retention
options.description: The number of retained versions of every password that is stored in the Safe.

options.name: safe_name
options.description: The unique name of the Safe.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the state needed for the user present for create user, absent for delete user.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the server to send data before giving up.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificate chain will not be validated.  This should only set to C(true) if you have a root CA certificate installed on each node.
